title: Confirm Tote Exchange Settings Method (Count vs Cube vs Cube and Count) for tote exchange evaluation
summary: Verify the selected Tote Exchange Settings Method (Count, Cube, or Cube and Count) in the Aveva API Tote Exchange Settings interface, and confirm whether tote exchange evaluation is based on counts, cube, or a mixture of both.
when_to_use: Use when you need to confirm which tote exchange evaluation basis is configured in Tote Exchange Settings—counts, cube, or a mixture—because the Method selection determines how thresholds are applied.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Open the Tote Exchange Settings Aveva API interface and read the Method field and the related threshold category fields shown on the page.
access_or_tools_needed: Aveva API access to the Tote Exchange Settings interface/page
Method field on the Tote Exchange Settings page

access_required: Aveva API access to the Tote Exchange Settings interface/page

visual_references.description: Tote Exchange Settings Aveva API page showing the Method field options (Count, Cube, Cube and Count) and threshold fields (Cube Threshold Pickup/Priority/Close and Count Threshold Pickup/Priority/Close).

steps.title: Open the Tote Exchange Settings Aveva API page
steps.purpose: Access the Tote Exchange Settings interface where the Method selection and related threshold fields are displayed.
steps.instruction: Open the Tote Exchange Settings Aveva API page/interface.
steps.expected_result: The Tote Exchange Settings page is visible with the Method field and the threshold fields grouped by Cube and Count.
steps.healthy_condition: The page shows the Method field with options including Count, Cube, and Cube and Count, and shows Cube Threshold Pickup/Priority/Close and Count Threshold Pickup/Priority/Close fields.
steps.failure_condition: The Tote Exchange Settings page cannot be opened or the Method field is not visible.

actions.label: Open Tote Exchange Settings page
actions.exact_action: Open the Tote Exchange Settings Aveva API page.

steps.title: Read the selected Method option (Count, Cube, or Cube and Count)
steps.purpose: Determine which evaluation basis the software will use for tote exchange thresholds.
steps.instruction: Find the Method field on the Tote Exchange Settings page and read the currently selected option.
steps.expected_result: You identify the selected Method as one of: Count, Cube, or Cube and Count.
steps.healthy_condition: The Method field displays one of the documented options: Count, Cube, or Cube and Count.
steps.failure_condition: The Method field does not show one of the documented options (Count/Cube/Cube and Count).

actions.label: Check Method field selection
actions.exact_action: Find the Method field and read the selected option.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Method field does not show one of the documented options (Count/Cube/Cube and Count), stop and escalate to the project team/UPS/UAT owner for clarification on the correct configuration interface.

steps.title: Interpret evaluation basis based on Method selection
steps.purpose: Translate the Method selection into the evaluation behavior (counts-only, cube-only, or mixture).
steps.instruction: Based on the Method selection you observed, determine whether tote exchange evaluation is based on counts, cube, or a mixture of both.
steps.expected_result: You can state the evaluation basis consistent with the Method selection: Count => counts; Cube => cube; Cube and Count => mixture of both.
steps.healthy_condition: Your interpretation matches the source-described behavior tied to the Method selection.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot map the observed Method selection to counts/cube/mixture behavior.

actions.label: Map Method to evaluation basis
actions.exact_action: If Method is set to Count, note evaluation is based off counts; if Cube, note evaluation is based off cube; if Cube and Count, note it allows a mixture of both.

steps.title: Record Method selection and relevant threshold category fields
steps.purpose: Ensure the configuration you report is consistent with the selected Method by capturing the relevant threshold fields shown on the page.
steps.instruction: Record the Method selection and the relevant threshold category fields shown on the Tote Exchange Settings page (Cube Threshold Pickup/Priority/Close and/or Count Threshold Pickup/Priority/Close) so the configuration matches the selected method.
steps.expected_result: You have documented the Method selection and the corresponding threshold fields visible on the page for Cube and/or Count.
steps.healthy_condition: The recorded fields correspond to the threshold groups displayed on the Tote Exchange Settings page: Cube Threshold Pickup/Priority/Close and Count Threshold Pickup/Priority/Close.
steps.failure_condition: You record only the Method without capturing the related threshold category fields shown on the page.

actions.label: Capture Method + threshold fields
actions.exact_action: Record the Method selection along with the relevant threshold category fields shown on the page (Cube Threshold Pickup/Priority/Close and/or Count Threshold Pickup/Priority/Close).

success_criteria: Method selection is identified as Count, Cube, or Cube and Count from the Tote Exchange Settings page.
The evaluation basis (counts, cube, or mixture) is correctly stated based on the Method selection.
The Method selection and the relevant threshold category fields (Cube and/or Count threshold Pickup/Priority/Close) are recorded.
healthy_conditions: Tote Exchange Settings page shows Method options Count, Cube, Cube and Count.
Cube Threshold Pickup/Priority/Close and Count Threshold Pickup/Priority/Close fields are visible on the page.
failure_conditions: Method field does not show one of the documented options (Count/Cube/Cube and Count).
Threshold fields cannot be found/recorded in the expected Cube/Count grouped categories on the page.
escalation_guidance: If the Method field does not show one of the documented options (Count/Cube/Cube and Count), stop and escalate to the project team/UPS/UAT owner for clarification on the correct configuration interface.
